**2026 & 2027 New Grads Welcome | Structured Mentorship | Urgent Care + General Practice**
Your first year shouldn’t mean getting thrown into the deep end. At Sploot, new graduates in Colorado Springs start with
**CAMP (Coaching And Mentorship Program)**
, a structured, one-on-one mentorship pathway that builds the clinical skills, confidence, and efficiency to practice independently, with a fully staffed nursing team and experienced doctors beside you every step of the way.
  
  
**What Makes Sploot Different**

* A primary mentor for questions, feedback, and support throughout the program
* A guided curriculum with knowledge and skills checks that adapts to your goals and the areas where you want the most experience
* Experience across multiple Sploot hospitals, learning from a variety of DVMs
* Highly skilled nursing team with up to a 3:1 nurse-to-DVM ratio
* Strong pre-visit triage so you walk into the exam room prepared
* No non-compete contracts — stay because you love it here

**Your Path to Independent Practice**

* **CAMP (first 6 weeks):**
  Paired one-on-one each shift with a senior DVM seeing the same schedule, learning the full scope of DVM responsibilities.
* **Continued mentorship:**
  Protected learning blocks built into your schedule taper as your confidence and caseload grow
* **3-month evaluation:**
  Once you’ve graduated from CAMP, a formal evaluation of your progress in clinical decision-making, case management, efficiency, client communication, medical records, and nurse delegation

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* DVM/VMD graduate, licensed (or eligible) in Colorado — fourth-year students are encouraged to apply
* Excited to learn, comfortable asking questions, and open to regular feedback
* A collaborative team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment and values a great work culture
* Bonus Points: previous experience as a veterinary technician or assistant, interest in surgery and dentistry, and excitement to grow with Sploot into a leadership role

**The Perks of the Pack**

* $130,000 starting base salary on a 4x10 schedule during CAMP
* ProSal model with 20–22% production once you graduate from CAMP
* Sign-on and relocation bonuses available
* 100% employer-paid medical insurance, plus dental, vision, and short-term disability options
* 401(k) with 4% match
* Up to 120 hours of PTO (increasing with tenure) plus 20 hours of holiday leave
* Up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave
* Unlimited CE reimbursement, up to 5 CE days per year, and $2,000 annually for CE travel
* Full coverage of licensing, DEA, liability, and professional memberships
* Free Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with mental health, legal, and financial counseling for you and your household
* Employee Pet Benefits to make sure your furry friends are covered

*Sploot is an equal opportunity employer and practices continuous hiring in accordance with Colorado state law. We welcome applications year-round and are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.*
